title: Zesty Crunchy Irish Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Irish stew featuring lamb, olives, and crunchy vegetables, perfect for a rainy day. This dish is low in sodium and packed with nutrients.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it starts to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the browned lamb, chicken broth, tomato paste, and green olives to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Stir in the chopped parsley and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
